target_profile.system_boundary: Captured OmniPaxos library and read MemoryStorage implementation; caller owns transport, polling, periodic ticks and starting a new configuration. Persistent backend and optional async runtime remain unread variants.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader aggregates per-pid promises and accepted indexes; followers validate ballot and receive ordering.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: BLE suggests ballots, persistent promises gate acceptance, and preparation carries prior accepted history.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Recovered promise and detected gaps initiate PrepareReq and log synchronization.
Configuration validation checks quorum overlap and basic scalar bounds; StopSign seals old instance and caller starts next membership.
Public reads delegate to InternalStorage, tagging entries below decided index and exporting compacted snapshots as copies.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: InternalStorage caches backend metadata, batches appends and applies atomic synchronization/compaction transactions; MemoryStorage is read and persistent backend remains an open variant.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Caller transports messages and calls tick, append and reads; tick drives election, retransmission branches and batch flushing.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
behaviors.trigger: New election result or incoming Prepare
implementation_guards: New local leadership requires ballot greater than leader_state and stored promise; follower Prepare requires greater promise or equal promise in Recover
writes: Flush batch, store promise; leader resets LeaderState and enters Prepare; follower resets receive sequence and caches Promise
external_effects: Leader sends Prepare; follower replies with accepted round/index and conditional log sync

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
implementation_guards: Promise and Accepted ballot must equal leader ballot; Accepted also requires Leader/Accept; prepare and accept quorum counts use per-pid slots
writes: Prepare quorum selects maximum accepted round/index history and maximum decided index; synchronizes log, appends pending proposals unless stopped; updates own accepted slot; Accepted overwrites sender slot and may advance decided index
external_effects: AcceptSync starts a per-follower sequence session; AcceptDecide carries entries and decided index; quorum decision produces Decide or updates buffered AcceptDecide

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
implementation_guards: Ballot equals stored promise; AcceptSync requires Follower/Prepare; AcceptDecide and StopSign require Follower/Accept and expected sequence; Decide requires Accept and expected sequence
writes: Synchronize or append before replying; monotonically advance decided index, flushing batches if necessary; install StopSign
external_effects: Accepted acknowledges persisted accepted index; AcceptSync forwards buffered proposals if no StopSign

behaviors.execution_owner: SequencePaxos initialization, reconnected and resend handlers
behaviors.protocol_context: One configured SequencePaxos instance and ballot
behaviors.trigger: Stored promise on construction, network reconnection, sequence gap or resend timeout
implementation_guards: Reconnect to current leader enters Recover; old ballot receives NotAccepted; larger unexpected ballot requests recovery
writes: PrepareReq at leader resets sender promise and cached outgoing acceptance metadata; follower enters Recover on sequence gap
external_effects: PrepareReq, Prepare and cached Promise retransmissions; Accept-phase resend handles StopSign and unpromised peers; ordinary Accept/Accepted retransmission is not present in these branches

cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovery enables equal-ballot Prepare to rebuild follower context.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Resynchronization restarts follower acceptance from selected leader history.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
implementation_guards: At least two nodes; nonzero configuration ID and local pid; own pid in nodes; flexible read/write quorum bounds and overlap; positive batching and election/resend timeouts.
external_effects: Build reads recovered promise, creates BLE, timers and SequencePaxos. reconfigure validates the proposed configuration before forwarding.
unknowns: Node-list uniqueness and cross-configuration message isolation are not checked in the read validation/dispatch paths; caller obligations need investigation.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
external_effects: Dispatch messages by enum without membership/configuration validation here. Drain protocol and BLE outgoing buffers. Tick drives election, resend and batch flush. Append delegates proposal acceptance, not a completed decision. Reconnected delegates recovery when caller reports reconnection.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Caller delivery drives promises and acceptance; flush timeout advances batched data.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Election timeout passes BLE result to handle_leader.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
behaviors.trigger: Preparation history selection or AcceptSync consumption
writes: sync_log first assigns cached accepted round and decided index. Complete snapshot replaces snapshot; Delta creates local decided snapshot then merges delta. Build one atomic backend transaction with round, decision, compaction, suffix and StopSign updates.
important_branches: Producer creates Delta from requested earlier decided index when it exceeds sender compacted index; otherwise produces Complete. create_log_sync uses snapshots only if snapshots are enabled and sender decided index exceeds common prefix.
Delta consumer constructs base using the already replaced cached decided index; its get_entries range may exceed locally available history.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reconstructed history supplies leader/follower accepted log and subsequent quorum acknowledgments.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Sync assigns accepted round to the new ballot context.

unknowns: Can a legal transfer with increasing decided index make the Delta base include overlapping entries or omit an unavailable range?

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
implementation_guards: Reject indexes above decided index; exclude StopSign from compacted ordinary entries.
writes: Snapshot creates data through selected boundary, then atomically trims, stores compacted index and snapshot; trim only removes data and advances compacted index.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
reads: Cached accepted/decided/compacted indexes and backend entries/snapshot
external_effects: Exports cloned entries marked Decided below cached decided index; compacted ranges return Snapshotted or Trimmed marker; decided suffix bounds read by current decided index.

behaviors.protocol_context: One configured replica and its log history
writes: MemoryStorage appends/truncates vectors and assigns metadata; reads return empty vector if full interval is absent. Cache reconstruction adds compacted offset and StopSign to log length. Batching only advances accepted index after append succeeds.
durable_effects: MemoryStorage has no crash durability; Storage trait requires ordered atomic transactions and rollback on Err. Persistent backend remains unread.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovered promise is loaded from supplied backend.

facts.meaning: The stored ballot is the ballot currently promised by this replica.
facts.validity_context: Until replaced by a qualifying Prepare or local leadership transition.
facts.durability: Written through InternalStorage; backend guarantees not yet inspected.
facts.recovery: Construction reads existing promise and enters Recover.

facts.meaning: The leader records each participant's most recently assigned accepted index for its current LeaderState.
facts.validity_context: LeaderState is replaced on new local leadership; incoming current-ballot Accepted overwrites the sender slot.
facts.recovery: New leadership starts zeroed accounting and rebuilds through synchronization acknowledgments.

facts.meaning: The stored snapshot is the value constructed or installed by the latest completed snapshot update, associated with the stored compacted index.
facts.validity_context: After successful snapshot/compaction or log synchronization until the next snapshot update.
facts.durability: Backend dependent; MemoryStorage keeps the values in memory; transactional updates use write_atomically.
facts.recovery: InternalStorage loads compacted index and read exports retrieve the backend snapshot.

surfaces.reason: Ordinary final AcceptDecide or Accepted loss has no resend in these branches. Does the transport contract require reliable delivery or reconnection notification, and which other trigger restores progress?
Current-ballot Accepted overwrites rather than maximizes per-pid index. Determine whether legal delayed acknowledgments affect only conservative accounting or also trim/progress consumers.
Delta base is constructed after replacing cached decided index; determine whether an actual producer can send a delta for a lower receiver boundary and whether reconstruction preserves the prefix.
Public dispatch adds no configuration/membership guard. Which routing duties isolate delayed old-configuration protocol messages?

formation.explanation: Leader preparation collects per-pid promises, selects prior history, enters Accept and synchronizes followers. Local proposals append/batch, followers acknowledge accepted indexes, and leader accepts a decision only after the configured acceptance quorum. Decision propagation uses Decide or piggybacking. Public reads export entries below cached decided index and return stored snapshot copies for compacted ranges. Batch acknowledgments reflect flushed entries; tick can flush incomplete batches.

context.explanation: BLE heartbeat rounds propose leadership; SequencePaxos only initiates local leadership above its prior leader and promise. A follower persists a qualifying promise before responding, rejects old ballots and requires preparation before AcceptSync. Recovery permits same-ballot Prepare; new local leadership resets support accounting. Build validates configuration and initializes clocks and recovered promise. Message dispatch itself adds no membership or configuration guard. Reconfiguration requires a decided StopSign before caller starts the next instance.

connection.explanation: Preparation flushes pending batches before reporting accepted history. The selected accepted round/index and decided index constrain the new leader history; pending proposals append only if no accepted StopSign. Current-ballot acceptance and per-follower message sequences qualify later advancement. Gaps request resynchronization; old ballots cannot directly append at followers. InternalStorage installs selected history and accepted round through an atomic storage transaction before acknowledgment. Snapshots can carry the decided prefix plus an ordinary suffix; the local Delta base boundary is an open discrepancy, not an established preservation guarantee.

open_details: Transport loss/reordering contract and caller reconnect duties.
Delayed same-ballot Accepted accounting and its independent consumers.
Delta snapshot producer boundary versus consumer base construction after decided-index update.
Cross-configuration message admission and node-list uniqueness caller duties.
Persistent backend and optional runtime variants are unread.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority transition, old-work recovery, storage and export paths are now connected. Local discrepancies remain hypotheses requiring applicable histories.
